body: 15 Nov 2026, OWNER: "I also want the ability to search in my liked playlist." N-25 is built for a playlist's page (S-17). Checked on the A35, build 156: the LIKED SONGS page (S-15) is a screen of its own with no Find field (header, three buttons, the songs). Filed as N-32 (draw S-15 with the field first, then reuse PlaylistFindField / PlaylistFindBar). The owner's 684-song playlist called 'liked' is an ordinary playlist and should already have the field: to be confirmed on the phone by whoever builds N-32.
